# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For the ChessEngine project, keep piece movement legality validation out for now; allow user moves without enforcing chess rules until requested.

## User Interface Guidelines
- For the board palette control, the gear should open a menu with a “Board Colors” option; selecting it opens a text-free palette view.
- Prefer a more visually diverse set of board color pairs in the palette picker, beyond small variations of one hue/saturation pattern.
- Make the popup and paired square tiles about twice their previous size while retaining a scrollable 2-column, roughly 5-row viewport.
